headline: Tampa win at Embry-Riddle
dek: Tampa won at Embry-Riddle on Monday, only the third defeat Embry-Riddle have suffered all season. Tampa had finished their ten conference matches five points below them, level with Palm Beach Atlantic and Rollins.
displaced_by: Embry-Riddle v Tampa, which the standing dek listed as still to come, has been played, and Tampa won it.
